title: Sales Manager - Gujarat & MP (Ahmedabad)
jobDescription: The Senior Sales Manager – Gujarat and MP is responsible for driving commercial growth, expanding market presence, and strengthening customer partnerships across the assigned territory. This role will focus on building a strong sales funnel, increasing market share, and leading strategic engagements with key accounts and stakeholders. This position is part of the Sales/Commercial organization and reports to the Regional Sales Manager – West. If you thrive in a fast paced, result driven, matrixed organization, and want to work to build a world-class commercial team, read on. Drive revenue growth and market expansion across the full Leica Biosystems portfolio within Clinical Diagnostics and Life Sciences segments. Build and manage a robust sales funnel, ensuring strong pipeline visibility and conversion. Develop and execute territory and key account strategies aligned with business objectives. Lead strategic customer engagements, including contract negotiations, pricing discussions, and multi-site partnerships. Drive competitive conversions and expand portfolio adoption within the installed base. Accelerate upselling and cross-selling across Histology, Advanced Staining, and Digital Pathology solutions. Establish and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and institutional stakeholders. Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Service, Applications, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to deliver customer value. Manage and develop channel partners/distributors to maximize regional coverage and performance. Analyze market trends, customer insights, and competitive activity to refine go-to-market strategies. Ensure accurate forecasting and CRM hygiene (SFDC), including win/loss analysis and opportunity tracking. Bachelors / Masters in field of Life Sciences/ Healthcare with a minimum of 8+ years of commercial experience in Medical Devices, Diagnostics, Healthcare, or Life Sciences. Experience in a combination of IVD instrumentation and consumables business and exposure to government tenders process will be added advantage. Work experience in CRMs like SFDC. Strong team player with excellent communication and negotiation skills with a scientific approach for the customers. A commercially minded professional with a track record of success in the IVD /medical device/life sciences/diagnostic industry. Ability to travel – 75% travel in month, within territory or locations. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Leica Biosystems can provide. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. Travel Requirements.

title: Regional Sales Manager- South, India ( Blr /Hyderabad)
jobDescription: This role report to the General Manager – India & South Asia and is expected to execute growth strategies and ensure strong regional contribution to India’s overall revenue commitments. If you thrive in a multifunctional, process oriented, fast paced, role and want to work to build a world-class Commercial organization—read on. Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with senior decision-makers, influencers, and clinical champions across key hospital groups in the South region. Lead strategic commercial engagements for major contract negotiations, pricing structures, and multi-site partnership agreements. Deliver revenue and margin targets for South India, ensuring effective execution of account strategies. Own and deliver annual bookings and revenue targets for the South region. Expand business in key hubs including Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Chennai. Identify new growth pockets across tier-2 cities and emerging private hospital chains. Drive competitive conversions and portfolio expansion within installed base. Analyze account-level performance, sales trends, customer preferences, and competitive activity to refine strategies and identify new opportunities. Build customized, multi-year key account plans aligned with customer priorities and Leica Biosystems’ strategic objectives. Ensure cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Service, Finance, Supply Chain, and Clinical Applications teams to support customer needs and deliver value. Forecast business performance accurately and maintain strong pipeline visibility in CRM (SFDC). 12+ years of commercial experience in Medical Devices / Diagnostics / Healthcare / Life Sciences, with 5+ years in People Management roles and leading regional sales team. Proven experience managing large hospital networks or corporate healthcare groups, including multi-stakeholder mapping and complex negotiation cycles. Strong capability in building strategic account plans and driving account growth. Deep understanding of sales performance metrics, pricing, margins, and value-based account development. Excellent communication, stakeholder influence, problem-solving, and presentation skills. Ability to travel up to 75% across South India. Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Science, Medical Technology, Business or related field. Experience in Pathology, Laboratory Diagnostics, Surgical Oncology, or Medical Device solutions. Strong familiarity with SFDC / CRM platforms and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Leica Biosystems can provide. Travel Requirements.
